P1 activates GET IN THERE (deplete Gor-blach, pick the blocked character, pay X): the character is destroyed, then P1 is offered P2 and P3 (the blocking defender is not forced). P1 picks P3: P3's faction takes X damage and P2's takes none; Gor-blach takes X damage. A second run choosing P2 damages only P2's faction.

P1's Silencer attacks P3's faction: P3's character with a token cannot block it and P3's character without a token can. Attacking P2's faction: P2's tokened character cannot block it. The restriction covers every player's characters with tokens; it does not depend on the opponent chosen for the other ability.

clauses.test3: P1 deploys Silencer: chooseOpponent offers P2 and P3 as it enters play. P1 chooses P2. A character entering play under P2's control lets P1 pay 1 (declinable) to put a token on it; a character entering play under P3's control does nothing. If P2 is eliminated, P1 chooses again (only P3 is left, so no choice is offered) and P3's characters now trigger it. With a single opponent left no choice appears at all.
